name: Manipur
metaTitle: Clinic & Hospital Management Software in Manipur | Lucoze
metaDescription: Lucoze is cloud clinic & hospital software for Imphal, Thoubal, Bishnupur, Kakching & Churachandpur: records, billing, ABHA number on record, DPDP-ready, data in India.
lead: Records, appointments, billing, lab and pharmacy on one platform your Imphal front desk can actually run. Cloud-based, ABDM-ready, and plain about what it does.
intro: Manipur runs on Imphal as its medical hub — patients travel in from the valley and the hill districts to see specialists, then travel back. When a patient returns three months later, their history should still be there, not in a paper file left at home. Lucoze keeps records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy on one platform so a patient's file follows them across visits. It's cloud software, works on ordinary broadband or mobile data, and your team logs in from any browser. English works throughout, which suits how most Manipur clinic front desks already operate.
points: Patient records, appointments, GST-compliant billing, lab reports and pharmacy stock live together. No stitching a diary, a billing book and a WhatsApp group into a workflow.
When someone from Churachandpur or Kakching travels to Imphal and comes back months later, their full history is one search away — not a file that stayed behind in another district.
ABHA number from the first visit
Record the ABHA number at registration so it is on the patient's file from day one. Built for DPDP 2023, with all patient data held in Indian data centres.

Lucoze is a lightweight cloud tool, so it's usable even on the patchy connections some hill districts get. But it is not offline software — you need a working connection to log in, and we won't pretend otherwise.
localContext: Manipur's main language is Meitei (Manipuri), and clinics also see patients who speak a range of hill-community languages — but English is common at front desks across Imphal, from Porompat to Lamphelpat and Thangmeiband, and Lucoze works fully in English. To be straight: the screens are in English only, in short plain labels a new receptionist can follow, and onboarding trains your desk on your own patients. Imphal is where valley and hill-district patients converge, so records that stay consistent across visits matter more here than most places.

faqs.q: What language does Lucoze run in?
faqs.a: The whole platform works in English, which suits most Manipur clinics. The labels are short and plain, and onboarding trains your front desk on your own patients.

All patient data is held in Indian data centres, and Lucoze is built for DPDP 2023 compliance with the ABHA number stored on every patient record. There's no lock-in — you can export your records to CSV or PDF whenever you want and take them with you.

faqs.q: Do you support clinics in Manipur?
faqs.a: Yes, remote-first. Our team is in Konnagar, Hooghly (West Bengal), so for Manipur we onboard over video, help migrate your existing records, and stay reachable on WhatsApp and chat. On-site visits are reserved for larger hospital deployments. Most clinics start with a 14-day trial and are live within 14 days.
